# La Bonita Brunch

> Family-owned Mexican breakfast, brunch and lunch food truck in Redmond, Oregon. Homemade breakfast burritos, burritos, tacos and flautas made with real eggs cracked to order. Order ahead for pickup online or get delivery on DoorDash. Menu guides and stories on the blog.

## Key facts

- Type: Food truck (Mexican breakfast & brunch)
- Ownership: Family-owned, women-owned and Latino-owned; run by Emmy and Oscar
- Award: 2026 Battle of the Food Trucks champion, voted by listeners of Rock 98.3 The Twins (Central Oregon)
- Languages: English and Spanish (¡Hablamos español!)
- Address: 958 NW 6th St, Redmond, OR 97756, USA (just north of Brightside Thrift)
- Phone: (541) 678-4991
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 am–2:30 pm; Saturday 7:00 am–2:00 pm; Sunday closed (Pacific Time)
- Ordering: Walk up to the window, or order ahead for pickup online
- Online ordering cutoff: 2:00 pm Monday–Friday and 1:30 pm Saturday
- Delivery: Available through DoorDash
- Ratings: 5.0 stars from 190+ Google reviews; 4.9 on Yelp
- Seating: Outdoor tables and umbrellas next to the truck; pets welcome
- Any burrito can be made as a bowl (no tortilla)
- Veterans get free coffee
- Prices: See current prices on the online ordering page; prices are not listed on the website

## Menu

Full menu page: https://labonitabrunch.net/menu. Current prices are on the online ordering page.

### Breakfast

- Ranchero Burrito: Runny eggs, beans, cheese, green salsa and sour cream.
- Breakfast Burrito: Your choice of meat, like bacon, with eggs, potato and cheese. Pair it with an ice-cold drink, café de olla and a dessert.
- Breakfast Asada Burrito: Carne asada, eggs, cheese and potato in a flour tortilla.
- Huevos & Winnies Burrito: Grilled winnies, eggs, potato and cheese. New.
- Nopal Burrito: Eggs, beans, cheese and nopales.
- Miles' Burrito: Eggs, beans and cheese.
- Mia's Burrito: Egg, potato and cheese.
- Chicken Breakfast: A chicken plate with eggs, cheese and potato.
- Breakfast Tacos (3): Three corn tortillas filled with your choice of protein, eggs, cheese and potatoes.
- Asada Breakfast Tacos (3): Three corn tortillas with carne asada, guacamole, onion and cilantro.

### Burritos

- Broadway Burrito: Carne asada, cheese, french fries, guacamole and sour cream.
- Chicken Burrito: Chicken, beans, cheese, tomato, onion, cilantro, lettuce and sour cream.
- Fish Burrito: Battered fish, cabbage, pico and special sauce.
- Asada Burrito: Carne asada, beans, cheese, tomato, onion, cilantro and guacamole. Try it with our green and habanero salsas.
- Shrimp Burrito: Grilled shrimp, cabbage, pico and special sauce. Try it as a bowl, no tortilla.
- Chile Relleno Burrito: Battered roasted pepper filled with cheese, with beans and sour cream.
- Bean & Cheese Burrito: Beans and cheese. Simple and perfect.

### Tacos & Flautas

- Day's Tacos (4): Four crispy potato tacos topped with lettuce, cheese, tomato and sour cream.
- Las Flautas: Rolled taquitos with your choice of beef or chicken, topped with sour cream, guacamole, cheese and lettuce.
- Asada Taco: Carne asada, onion, cilantro and guacamole on a corn tortilla.
- Shrimp Taco: Grilled shrimp, cabbage, pico and special sauce.
- Chicken Taco: Chicken, onion, cilantro and lettuce.
- Fish Taco: Battered fish, cabbage, pico and special sauce.
- Taco Chile Relleno (2): Two corn tortillas with chile relleno, cheese, beans and sour cream.
- Bean N Cheese Taco: Beans and cheese in a flour tortilla.

### Sweets

- Churro Bites (8): Eight churro bites with cinnamon sugar and cajeta, Mexican caramel.
- Carlota: A no-bake Mexican icebox cake: creamy layers of lemon cookies topped with cajeta caramel.

### Drinks & Sides

- Café de Olla: Mexican spiced coffee, freshly brewed. Free for veterans.
- Mexican Coca-Cola: Made with pure cane sugar, in the glass bottle.
- Jarritos: Pineapple, lime, mandarin, fruit punch or tamarind.
- Red Bull: Ice cold.
- Juice: Orange or apple.
- Ice Tea: Sugar-free green iced tea.
- Bottled Water: 16.9 oz Aquafina.
- Guacamole: Made fresh every day.
- Green Salsa: Our house green salsa.
- Habanero Salsa: Our house habanero salsa.
- Crema: Side of sour cream.
- Beans: Side of beans.
- Fries: Side of fries.

## FAQ

**Where is La Bonita Brunch?**
We're a food truck at 958 NW 6th St in Redmond, Oregon, just north of Brightside Thrift.

**What are your hours?**
We're open Monday through Friday from 7:00 am to 2:30 pm and Saturday from 7:00 am to 2:00 pm. We're closed on Sunday. Online orders are taken until 2:00 pm on weekdays and 1:30 pm on Saturday.

**What kind of food do you serve?**
We serve homemade Mexican breakfast and brunch: breakfast burritos, burritos, tacos, flautas, churro bites and carlota.

**Can I order online?**
Yes. You can order ahead for pickup through our Clover online ordering page.

**Do you deliver?**
Yes. You can get delivery through DoorDash.

**Do you speak Spanish?**
Yes. ¡Hablamos español! Our family speaks English and Spanish.

**Can I get my burrito as a bowl?**
Yes. Any burrito can be made as a bowl with no tortilla.

**Do you have meatless options?**
Yes. The Ranchero, Nopal, Miles', Mia's and Bean & Cheese burritos, Day's Tacos and the Bean N Cheese Taco have no meat.

**Do you offer anything for veterans?**
Yes. Coffee is free for veterans. Just let us know at the window.

**Is there seating?**
Yes. We have tables and umbrellas next to the truck where you can eat or wait for your order.

**Have you won any awards?**
Yes. La Bonita Brunch won the 2026 Battle of the Food Trucks, voted by listeners of Rock 98.3 The Twins in Central Oregon.

**Are your eggs fresh?**
Yes. We crack real eggs for every order. We never use powdered or pre-packaged eggs.
